name: AI Assistant API
description: API endpoints for interacting with the AI assistant and managing AI assistant conversations.

endpoints.name: Ask AI Assistant
endpoints.description: Sends a natural-language question to the AI assistant and returns its answer.

message.description: The user's question, in plain language.
message.example: How much profit did I make this month?

conversationId.description: The ID of an existing conversation. Use null when starting a new conversation.

200.description: AI assistant successfully answered the question.

data.answer: You made an estimated GHS 1,860 profit this month. This is a medium-confidence estimate — do a stock count for an exact figure.

endpoints.name: List Conversations
endpoints.description: Returns the current user's AI chat history, most recently active first, with a one-message preview of each conversation.
notes: The messages array contains at most one message.
The message is the most recent message and is used as a conversation preview.
The full transcript can be retrieved using Get Conversation.

endpoints.name: Get Conversation
endpoints.description: Returns one conversation with its full message history, oldest first.
endpoints.access: Any authenticated, verified user. Only the user's own conversations can be accessed.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to retrieve.

messages.content: How much profit did I make this month?

404.description: Conversation does not exist or belongs to a different user.

endpoints.name: Update Conversation
endpoints.description: Renames a conversation and/or changes its status, such as archiving it.
endpoints.access: Any authenticated, verified user. Only the user's own conversations can be updated.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to update.

notes: Only the fields that need to be changed should be sent.

404.description: Conversation does not exist or belongs to a different user.

endpoints.name: Delete Conversation
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes a conversation and all of its messages.
endpoints.access: Any authenticated, verified user. Only the user's own conversations can be deleted.

conversationId.description: The ID of the conversation to delete.

404.description: Conversation does not exist or has already been deleted.

notes: The conversation and all of its messages are permanently removed.
